AND.condition: Histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate
Metastatic bone disease confirmed by CT, MRI, or bone scan
Plans to start or be < 30 days from beginning androgen deprivation therapy

OR.condition: Patients may receive palliative radiation therapy at the investigators discretion during the first 4 weeks of beginning protocol therapy

NOT.condition: Patients with lymph node or visceral metastases only
Neuroendocrine, small cell or transitional cell cancer of the prostate
Abnormal bone metabolism (i.e., Paget's disease, untreated hyperthyroidism, untreated hyperprolactinemia, untreated Cushing's disease)
Use of calcitonin within 14 days before being registered for protocol therapy or any previous use of bisphosphonates
Major surgery within 4 weeks of registration to protocol therapy
Adjuvant chemotherapy within 6 months of registration to protocol therapy
Hormonal therapy in the adjuvant setting within 12 months of registration to protocol therapy; previous hormonal therapy must not have exceeded 6 months
Prior history of malignancy in the past 5 years with the exception of basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
History of allergy or drug reactions to bisphosphonates
